date_display_zh: 2026 年 4 月 21 日·星期二
tagline_zh: 由 AI 為你策展，專屬早晨讀物

articles.title_zh: Apple 執行長庫克將交棒給 Ternus，迎戰 AI 轉型關鍵時刻
articles.title_en: Apple's incoming CEO Ternus faces defining moment as AI reshapes the industry
articles.lede_zh: Apple 執行長庫克宣布將於九月卸任，由硬體主管 Ternus 接掌公司領導權。這家公司正面臨人工智慧浪潮，新任執行長必須帶領 iPhone 製造商完成產業轉型。
articles.lede_en: Apple CEO Tim Cook announced he will step down in September, with hardware chief John Ternus taking the helm. The incoming CEO must navigate one of the tech industry's most consequential transitions as artificial intelligence reshapes product strategy and market dynamics.
bullets_zh: 庫克將轉任 Apple 執行董事長
Ternus 主管硬體工程，面臨 AI 產品化挑戰
iPhone 銷售與 AI 策略成關鍵考驗
bullets_en: Cook will transition to executive chairman role
Ternus leads hardware engineering, faces AI productization challenge
iPhone sales performance and AI strategy will define early tenure

articles.title_zh: Microsoft 研究探討：AI 能否拯救地球？
articles.title_en: Microsoft Research examines whether AI can contribute to global sustainability efforts
articles.lede_zh: Microsoft Research 推出播客節目，邀請永續專家與研究人員討論 AI 在氣候建模、能源最佳化及環境監測中的角色，分析人工智慧對減碳的實際貢獻與限制。
articles.lede_en: Microsoft Research released a podcast episode featuring sustainability experts Doug Burger, Amy Luers, and Ishai Menache, who discuss AI's potential contributions to climate modeling, energy optimization, and environmental monitoring while examining the technology's carbon footprint concerns.
bullets_zh: AI 應用涵蓋氣候建模與能源管理領域
專家評估 AI 減碳效益與能耗成本
永續 AI 發展方向仍待產業驗證
bullets_en: AI applications span climate modeling and energy management domains
Experts weigh decarbonization benefits against energy consumption costs
Sustainable AI development direction awaits broader industry validation

articles.title_zh: NVIDIA Jetson 邊緣裝置記憶體最佳化指南
articles.title_en: NVIDIA Jetson guide details memory optimization techniques for edge AI model deployment
articles.lede_zh: NVIDIA 發表技術文章，說明如何在 Jetson 邊緣裝置上以有限的記憶體執行十億參數等級的 AI 模型，涵蓋量化、記憶體管理及多管線最佳化等策略。
articles.lede_en: NVIDIA published a technical blog post detailing memory optimization strategies for running multi-billion-parameter AI models on Jetson edge devices. The guide covers quantization techniques, memory management across CPU and GPU shared resources, and multi-pipeline optimization for real-time performance under power and thermal constraints.
bullets_zh: 邊緣裝置記憶體限制影響模型部署規模
最佳化策略涵蓋量化與管線並行技術
Jetson 開發者可提升相同硬體執行效能
bullets_en: Edge device memory constraints limit model deployment scale
Optimization strategies cover quantization and pipeline parallel techniques
Jetson developers can improve performance on same hardware configuration

articles.title_zh: NVIDIA 推出端到端 FP8 強化學習訓練最佳化
articles.title_en: NVIDIA enables high-throughput RL training with end-to-end FP8 precision support
articles.lede_zh: 隨著大型語言模型從文字生成邁向複雜推理，強化學習扮演日益核心的角色。NVIDIA 推出端到端 FP8 精度的強化學習訓練方案，提升訓練吞吐量並維持模型品質。
articles.lede_en: As large language models advance from simple text generation to complex reasoning capabilities, reinforcement learning has become central to development. NVIDIA's FP8 precision approach to RL training enables higher throughput while maintaining model quality across the training pipeline.
bullets_zh: 強化學習成為大型模型推理能力核心技術
FP8 精度支援提升訓練系統吞吐量
模型品質在降精度下仍保持穩定
bullets_en: Reinforcement learning becomes core technique for model reasoning capabilities
FP8 precision support boosts training system throughput significantly
Model quality remains stable under reduced precision training conditions

articles.title_zh: 新竹物流遭網攻停擺兩天，已向警大科偵隊報案
articles.title_en: HCT Logistics services disrupted for two days after cyber attack
articles.lede_zh: 新竹物流自四月十七日起多項系統服務中斷，起初稱系統當機，後證實遭網路攻擊。司機無法配送貨物，公司於四月二十日向刑事警察局科技犯罪偵查隊報案。
articles.lede_en: HCT Logistics experienced system service disruptions starting April 17, initially attributed to system crashes before confirming a cyber attack. Many drivers were unable to deliver goods, and the company filed a report with Taipei City Police Department's cybersecurity crime unit on April 20.
bullets_zh: 攻擊發生於四月十七日，服務中斷達兩天
多名司機無法配送，只能於營業所待命
公司於MOPS發布重大訊息並報案調查
bullets_en: Attack occurred on April 17, services disrupted for two days
Multiple drivers unable to deliver, held at distribution centers
Company issued stock market disclosure and filed police report

articles.title_zh: AI公司Context遭竊資攻擊，疑引發Vercel資料外洩
articles.title_en: AI company Context malware attack suspected trigger for Vercel data breach
articles.lede_zh: 威脅情報公司 HudsonRock 調查指出，AI 工具公司 Context 約兩個月前有員工電腦感染 Lumma Stealer 竊資軟體，該事件被認為是雲端開發平台 Vercel 資料外洩事故的導火線。
articles.lede_en: Threat intelligence firm HudsonRock revealed that employees at AI tool company Context were infected with Lumma Stealer malware approximately two months ago, and the incident is suspected to have triggered the data breach at cloud development platform Vercel, where hackers penetrated internal environments and claimed to have stolen sensitive data.
bullets_zh: Context 員工電腦感染 Lumma Stealer 竊資軟體
攻擊事件與 Vercel 資料外洩存在關聯
駭客聲稱已取得平台內部機敏資料
bullets_en: Context employees' computers infected with Lumma Stealer malware
Attack event linked to Vercel platform data breach incident
Hackers claim to have obtained sensitive internal platform data

articles.title_zh: Git 2.54 正式發布，新增實驗性 history 指令
articles.title_en: Git 2.54 released with experimental history command for simpler commit rewriting
articles.lede_zh: Git 2.54 正式發布，包含來自超過 137 位貢獻者的更新，其中 66 位為首次貢獻。最引人注目的是新增的實驗性 git history 指令，提供更簡易的 commit 訊息修改與拆分功能。
articles.lede_en: Git 2.54 has been released with updates from over 137 contributors, including 66 first-timers. The most notable addition is the experimental git history command, which provides simpler commit message rewording and commit-splitting capabilities without the complexity of interactive rebase workflows.
bullets_zh: 超過137位貢獻者參與，66位首次貢獻
新增 git history reword 與 split 指令
操作不需觸及工作樹，支援裸倉庫
bullets_en: Over 137 contributors participated, 66 making first contributions
New git history reword and split commands introduced
Operations avoid touching working tree, support bare repositories

articles.title_zh: 個人化 CRISPR 療法即將擴展：從罕病到千名病患
articles.title_en: Personalized CRISPR gene therapies set to reach thousands of patients with rare diseases
articles.lede_zh: Nature 報導指出，個人化 CRISPR 基因編輯療法正邁向更廣泛的臨床應用，未來可能惠及數千名患有罕見遺傳疾病的病患，標誌著基因醫學的一大進步。
articles.lede_en: Nature reports that personalized CRISPR gene editing therapies are advancing toward broader clinical deployment, potentially benefiting thousands of patients with rare genetic diseases. This marks a significant milestone in precision medicine, as researchers develop scalable approaches to individually tailored genetic treatments.
bullets_zh: CRISPR 個人化療法邁向大規模臨床部署
目標惠及數千名罕見遺傳疾病患者
基因醫學朝向精準化、客製化方向發展
bullets_en: CRISPR personalized therapies advancing toward large-scale clinical deployment
Target to benefit thousands of rare genetic disease patients
Genetic medicine moving toward precision and customization approaches

articles.title_zh: 南加大教授 Maja Matarić 開創社交輔助機器人
articles.title_en: USC professor Maja Matarić pioneered socially assistive robotics for mental health and therapy
articles.lede_zh: 南加大教授 Maja Matarić 在 2005 年協助定義了社交輔助機器人領域，開發能與人類對話、遊戲互動並回應情緒的機器人，用於自閉症兒童治療與學生心理健康輔導。
articles.lede_en: USC professor Maja Matarić helped define the socially assistive robotics field in 2005, developing robots capable of conversation, game-playing, and emotional response for autism spectrum therapy and student mental health support. She received the 2025 MassRobotics Robotics Medal for advancing the field through cognitive behavioral therapy applications.
bullets_zh: 2005年協助定義社交輔助機器人新領域
機器人可用於自閉症治療與學生心理輔導
榮獲2025年MassRobotics機器人學獎章
bullets_en: Helped define socially assistive robotics field beginning in 2005
Robots applicable to autism treatment and student mental health support
Awarded 2025 MassRobotics Robotics Medal for field advancement

articles.title_zh: 日本放寬武器出口規定，戰後和平主義重大轉變
articles.title_en: Japan loosens arms export rules, marking a significant break from post-WW2 pacifist policy
articles.lede_zh: 日本放寬長年以來的武器出口限制，此舉標誌著該國二戰後和平主義國防政策的重大轉變，預計將開啟向十餘國出口武器的新局面。
articles.lede_en: Japan has relaxed its longstanding arms export restrictions, marking a significant departure from its post-World War II pacifist defense posture. The policy shift is expected to open the door for Japan to sell weapons to more than a dozen countries, reshaping regional security dynamics.
bullets_zh: 日本放寬武器出口多年來的嚴格限制
二戰後和平主義國防政策出現重大轉變
預計將向十多國開啟武器出口新局面
bullets_en: Japan relaxes long-standing strict weapons export restrictions
Major shift from post-WW2 pacifist defense policy direction
Expected to open arms export markets to over a dozen nations
